description: This Go source file defines functionality related to ordering files based on their relative paths within a documentation directory structure. It includes a data type for representing files with their paths, and a function to order a list of files relative to a documentation root, handling errors for invalid paths.

classes.name: orderedFile
classes.description: A struct representing a file with its absolute and relative paths.

methods.name: orderFiles
methods.description: Orders a list of files based on their relative paths to a given documentation root.
